deficiencies.description: The rewrite describes the tumour as occurring 'in a meningioma', treating 'meningioma' as an anatomical site or location alongside 'in the liver', whereas a meningioma is itself a type of tumour.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Only 10% of these deaths, generally, if they're occurring in things like the meningioma that I was telling you about or in the liver.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: for example when the tumour occurs in a meningioma or in the liver.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite introduces the word 'therefore' to assert a causal link between the small size of the niche and the tumour interfering with the bone marrow, whereas the source text merely places the two statements consecutively without stating a causal relation.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: This niche is not very big. This will interfere with your bone marrow, and it will result in things like infection and anemia as well.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This niche is not very big. The tumour will therefore interfere with the bone marrow, and this results in infection and anaemia as well.

considerations.sourcePassage: And if you think about them in the different settings in which they occur, things like a meningioma will cause pressure.
considerations.reason: 'Other effects depend on the site' introduces the second paragraph of examples, which continues the lecturer's overarching framing of effects occurring 'in the different settings in which they occur'.

considerations.sourcePassage: tumors in bones lead to erosion of that bone function, so you can get fractures
considerations.reason: 'erosion of the bone' instead of 'erosion of that bone function' conveys the exact same clinical meaning in this context.

considerations.sourcePassage: And also this competition with the normal
considerations.reason: 'Competition with normal tissue is also a factor' appropriately renders the lecturer's conversational shorthand 'competition with the normal'.
